method: Observed the public PageSpeed Insights report in Chrome; values transcribed as displayed.

field_data.interpretation: No real-user Core Web Vitals baseline; lab TBT is not field INP.

mobile_findings.image_examples: Several small portfolio thumbnails fetched the 480px derivative. Smaller responsive variants and accurate sizes can reduce transfer without changing full-size photographs.
mobile_findings.cache_examples: Image and logo requests in the report showed Cache TTL None.

limits: One before-release lab report, not a field-data result or a ranking guarantee.
Scores vary by run and network.
The earlier API quota failure remains historical; this successful browser report supersedes the lack of a lab score.
